sn15.9:1.3: pubbākoṭi na paññāyati avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaṃyojanānaṃ sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ.
sn15.9:1.4: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, daṇḍo upari vehāsaṃ khitto sakimpi mūlena nipatati, sakimpi majjhena nipatati. sakimpi aggena nipatati,
sn15.9:1.5: evameva kho bhikkhave avijjānīvaraṇā sattā taṇhāsaṃyojanā sandhāvantā saṃsarantā sakimpi asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ gacchanti. sakimpi parasmā lokā imaṃ lokaṃ āgacchanti.
